description: PHP source file defining an XHTML sanitizer class for MediaWiki, including functions for cleaning, validating, and encoding HTML and XML content, as well as regular expressions and constants used for sanitization.

classes.name: Sanitizer
classes.description: A class providing static methods for sanitizing HTML/XML content, removing dangerous tags/attributes, validating and encoding entities, and handling character references in the context of MediaWiki.

methods.name: removeHTMLtags
methods.description: Cleans up HTML, removes dangerous tags and attributes, and removes HTML comments.

methods.name: removeHTMLcomments
methods.description: Removes HTML comments and related whitespace.

methods.name: validateTagAttributes
methods.description: Normalizes and validates HTML tag attributes against a whitelist.

methods.name: validateAttributes
methods.description: Discards attributes not in the whitelist and sanitizes attribute values.

methods.name: mergeAttributes
methods.description: Merges two sets of HTML attributes, combining classes when both are present.

methods.name: checkCss
methods.description: Checks CSS for forbidden or unsafe structures, returns sanitized string or false.

methods.name: fixTagAttributes
methods.description: Normalizes and sanitizes a fragment of HTML tag attributes for safe inclusion.

methods.name: encodeAttribute
methods.description: Encodes attribute values for safe HTML output.

methods.name: safeEncodeAttribute
methods.description: Encodes attribute values with extra escaping to prevent further wiki processing.

methods.name: escapeId
methods.description: Escapes a string for use as an HTML id attribute, ensuring valid characters.

methods.name: escapeClass
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a valid CSS class name.

methods.name: escapeHtmlAllowEntities
methods.description: Escapes HTML content but preserves entities.

methods.name: decodeTagAttributes
methods.description: Extracts attribute name-value pairs from a tag fragment, decoding entities.

methods.name: getTagAttributeCallback
methods.description: Determines the correct attribute value from regex match groups.

methods.name: normalizeAttributeValue
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace and character references in an attribute value.

methods.name: normalizeWhitespace
methods.description: Replaces various whitespace characters with a space.

methods.name: normalizeCharReferences
methods.description: Converts character references to normalized forms, ensuring validity.

methods.name: normalizeCharReferencesCallback
methods.description: Callback for regex replacement, normalizing character references.

methods.name: normalizeEntity
methods.description: Returns a valid entity reference for a named or unknown entity.

methods.name: decCharReference
methods.description: Converts a decimal codepoint to a character reference if valid.

methods.name: hexCharReference
methods.description: Converts a hex codepoint to a character reference if valid.

methods.name: validateCodepoint
methods.description: Checks if a Unicode codepoint is valid in XML.

methods.name: decodeCharReferences
methods.description: Decodes all character references in a string to UTF-8.

methods.name: decodeCharReferencesCallback
methods.description: Callback for regex replacement, decoding character references.

methods.name: decodeChar
methods.description: Returns a UTF-8 string for a valid codepoint or replacement character.

methods.name: decodeEntity
methods.description: Decodes a named entity into UTF-8 or returns a pseudo-source.

methods.name: attributeWhitelist
methods.description: Provides the list of valid attributes for a specific element.

methods.name: setupAttributeWhitelist
methods.description: Sets up the whitelist of allowed HTML attributes per element.

methods.name: stripAllTags
methods.description: Removes all HTML tags and encodes as plain text.

methods.name: hackDocType
methods.description: Generates a DOCTYPE declaration with entity definitions for XHTML.

methods.name: cleanUrl
methods.description: Normalizes and validates a URL, removing illegal characters.
